## Reproduction script

Commands in execution order; re-run inside an equivalent environment to reproduce the artifacts above.

```sh
pixi install
pixi install
curl -fsSL -o bin/pandora https://github.com/iqbal-lab-org/pandora/releases/download/0.12.0-alpha.0/pandora-linux-precompiled-v0.12.0-alpha.0 && chmod +x bin/pandora && bin/pandora --version
curl -fsSL -o data/ecoli_panrg.zip https://figshare.com/ndownloader/files/54318899 && ls -la data
pixi run curl -fsSL -o data/GCF_025392675.1_ASM2539267v1_genomic.fna.gz https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/025/392/675/GCF_025392675.1_ASM2539267v1/GCF_025392675.1_ASM2539267v1_genomic.fna.gz && ls -la data
curl -fsSL -o data/Escherichia.coli.panidx.zip https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/54318899 && pixi run python -I -c "import zipfile;zipfile.ZipFile('data/Escherichia.coli.panidx.zip').extractall('data/panrg')" && ls -la data/panrg
curl -fsSL https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR131/089/SRR13116389/SRR13116389_1.fastq.gz | gzip -dc | head -n 400000 | gzip > data/SRR13116389_100k.fastq.gz; ls -la data/SRR13116389_100k.fastq.gz
pixi run amrfinder -u
gzip -dc data/GCF_025392675.1_ASM2539267v1_genomic.fna.gz > data/GCF_025392675.1.fna && pixi run amrfinder -n data/GCF_025392675.1.fna -O Escherichia --plus --threads 4 -o results/amrfinderplus/GCF_025392675.1.amrfinderplus.tsv --nucleotide_output results/amrfinderplus/GCF_025392675.1.amr_genes.fna
pixi install
pixi run amrfinder -u
pixi install --all
pixi run -e amrfinder amrfinder -u
pixi run -e amrfinder amrfinder -n data/GCF_025392675.1.fna -O Escherichia --plus --threads 4 -o results/amrfinderplus/GCF_025392675.1.amrfinderplus.tsv --nucleotide_output results/amrfinderplus/GCF_025392675.1.amr_genes.fna
```
